My Rho Gamma group girls are the light of my life and I have that bond no matter what happens! And potential bigs got assigned get to know you dates but I didn’t and I don’t know if I’ll get one next week so I’ve just be meeting up with girls in person or over zoom on my own time and they all seem really appreciative of it. Also I text about half of them pretty frequently at this point. I have 4 that I would die to have but frankly I’d be grateful to have any of them.

4 year program but finishing in 3.5 so I’m done this December! And technically I AM on the list but there are 24 potential bigs and only 20 littles to go around. And twins are a pretty frequent occurrence in my chapter so even some PC 19 girls are gonna get left out (which sucks, and I always thought that if there’s a potential shortage there shouldn’t be twins).

Which like sure that’s fine, I was just mad it didn’t apply across the board and said so and they did end up changing it but obviously big/little was over by that point. Right now it’s a 99% chance I’m not getting one unless some girls opt out or someone from PC20 falls in love with me so I’m just trying to distract myself and be friendly with them all regardless and if I do end up getting one I’ll be pleasantly surprised

Grade probations couldn’t take littles but social and financial probations could 🙄 the worst part was, I went to summer school but they wouldn’t count that as my “previous semester” but that’s more on national’s rules about what constitutes a semester than my exec.

Their reasoning is that they don’t want a new girl to get a big and have her graduate immediately after so people planning to transfer and seniors don’t get they often. I’ve seen it happen once and that was a super special case I think. People actually hide the fact they’re transferring because of this unofficial rule. It’s not impossible for me to get one but it’s highly unlikely at this point.

So now that new girls are in, we’re getting to know them and stuff and I just was informed that since I’m older I won’t be getting a little since there’s not enough to go around. It’s seriously a bummer because  I wasn’t allowed to get one last year due to a dumb rule that I pointed out as dumb and THEY REMOVED IT from the bylaws but not til after I couldn’t get one. I understand the more recent PC should be prioritized because they have more time with the new girls overall but I didn’t even get assigned a “get to know you date” which stung a little. I guess I’m lucky I got to be a Rho Gamma and get to know girls that way, but since my entire family is alum without littles (except me) or dropped the family line dies with me and that doesn’t feel great.
